links.outcome: Sensitivity and specificity for ICH on local consecutive CT scans versus expert-consensus ground truth
links.effect: Sensitivity 0.92 (CI 0.84-0.96), specificity 0.96 (CI 0.94-0.98) in the global dataset; radiologist sensitivity 0.88, specificity 0.98. 13/14 subarachnoid hemorrhages detected.
links.quote: VeriScout<sup>™</sup> detected hemorrhage with a sensitivity of 0.92 (CI 0.84-0.96) and a specificity of 0.96 (CI 0.94-0.98) in the global dataset, exceeding the sensitivity of general radiologists (0.88) with only a minor relative decrement in specificity (0.98).

links.outcome: AI performance in scans with artefact or postoperative change versus overall
links.effect: No decrement in performance in scans containing artefact or postoperative change.
links.quote: There was no decrement in the performance of VeriScout<sup>™</sup> in scans containing artefact or postoperative change.

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic accuracy and workflow feasibility of an intracranial hemorrhage triage AI tool on a consecutive retrospective cohort of head CT scans.
